## Ctx.handleSessionCallbackData() method

Session-aware route handler for callback queries without args.

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
handleSessionCallbackData?(): Promise<any>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;any&gt;

## Remarks

Mirrors the corresponding `handle*` method. Dispatched automatically by `_pageRoutes` id=1 (session routing) when: 1. The user has an active session (`session.method` is set) 2. `session.method` matches the method key registered for this route (computed by the corresponding `methodSession*()`<!-- -->) 3. The route name ends with `fromListener` — ensuring only the correct update type triggers it (callback queries match `*CallbackData` only; text matches `*Text` only; etc.)

Define `handleSession*` to handle session flows separately from normal flows. The regular `handle*` will only be called for non-session flows because id=1 dispatches before id=2 ever runs.

Works with ALL route types: CallbackData, ArgsCallbackData, Text, CommandText, FreeText, CaptionPhoto, etc.

## Example 1


```typescript
// handle* — invoked via id=2 (static) when no session matches in id=1
async handleCallbackData() {
  await this.edit(`normal flow: ${this.callbackData}`)
}

// handleSession* — invoked via id=1 (session) when session.method matches
async handleSessionCallbackData() {
  const {inputText} = this.temp.session.params
  await this.edit(`session-active: ${inputText}`)
}
```

## Example 2


```typescript
async handleArgsCallbackData() {
  await this.edit(`normal: ${this.callbackData}`)
}
async handleSessionArgsCallbackData() {
  const {inputText} = this.temp.session.params
  await this.edit(`session: ${this.callbackData}, params: ${inputText}`)
}
```
